name: Nguom Ngao Cave
summary: Walk the lit passage at Nguom Ngao, the cave about 4 km from Ban Gioc. Do it on the same day as the falls. The floor is wet. The system is more than 2,000 m, with three mouths, and it is also 2,144 m with 948 m open. The Ban Thuon branch is a longer, rougher visit. The fee and the time inside are check on arrival.
getThere: About 4 km from Ban Gioc, on the same Dam Thuy day.
heroCaption: A lit chamber in Nguom Ngao, with stalactite columns

notice.title: The long branch is not the lit walk
notice.body: The ordinary visit is the lit passage. The Ban Thuon branch, opened in 2021, is nearly 3 km, with climbing and wading. Do not budget them as the same walk.

body: The ordinary visit is an electrically lit passage at Ban Gun. The Tay name is tiger cave. Guides point out a golden falls, a silver falls, an upside-down lotus, and terraces. The floor is wet, so wear shoes you can soak.

Keep both lengths. The cave is more than 2,000 m, with three mouths: Nguom Ngao, Nguom Lom, and Ban Thuon. It is also 2,144 m, with 948 m open to ordinary visitors. From 2021 the Ban Thuon branch, nearly 3 km, is a rougher visit with climbing and wading.
Do this with the falls, in the morning or early afternoon. Time inside is check on arrival. The fee is check on arrival. Confirm you are buying the lit walk before you pay.

figures.caption: The lit walkway inside Nguom Ngao
figures.alt: A path through a yellow-lit chamber of Nguom Ngao cave, with stalactites overhead

gettingThere: Nguom Ngao is at Ban Gun, in Dam Thuy, about 4 km from Ban Gioc. Go with the falls day. The city is more than 80 km from the valley, and the minutes on that road are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Ban Gioc
legs.body: About 4 km on the cave road. The minutes are check on arrival. Khuoi Ky, a stone stilt-house village, sits beside this road.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: The eastern road, more than 80 km to the valley, then the short hop to the cave. Drive minutes are check on arrival.

admissionNote: Check on arrival. The lit walk and the Ban Thuon branch are different visits. Confirm which one the ticket is for.
